_comment: Second-difference spike-ratio ceilings for src/scripts/test_banding.sh (#1627). Derived via a RED run (tools/budget_init.py pattern): every (fixture, stage, ramp_axis) cell was measured across the full slider-extreme sweep (baseline, exposure+4, contrast+100, shadows+100, blacks-100, saturation+100, vibrance+100, hsl_saturation+100 all-bands), the worst observed max_spike_ratio / max_abs_d2 recorded, then +8%/+10% headroom applied (floor 1.2 / 0.001) so a sub-percent noise wobble on a re-run doesn't flip PASS to FAIL. One-way ratchet: lower these only in the same commit that delivers the improvement (never invented round numbers). hsl_saturation+100 (#1733) did not move any worst-case cell vs the original 7-case sweep, confirming the hsl.rs gamut-soft-knee fix holds at the pipeline level.
